newsitem.title: UK: Panamax grain trades lead BFI 10 points higher.
newsitem.headline: Panamax grain trades lead BFI 10 points higher.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was up 10 points on Thursday to 1450 points.

Brokers said the firmer rates were reported in all the principle Panamax grain trades - Cargill fixed 3 million cu ft grain Mississippi to Holland for end Feb at $12.90 basis 49 ft, Andre fixed Cho Yang tonnage 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan mid-March at $26.00 no combination and 54,000 heavy grain NoPac to Taiwan has been fixed for March 1/15 at $14.50.
Grain rates from the Plate and Brazil continued to improve for Handy-sizes.
The Baltic Handy Index was up eight points to 1,016 on the strength of marginally firmer timechatrer rates worldwide.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was following the improved sentiment of the underlying market with gains of 12 to 38 points and turnover totalled 229 lots.
